At Trillium Spinal Care in Altoona, Wisconsin and Plainview, Minnesota we use extremely precise advanced Upper Cervical Chiropractic techniques to improve the health and life of our patients. 

The Upper Cervical Chiropractic care technique we use is called NUCCA and it is a very gentle technique that does not utilize twisting, popping or cracking. Our safe approach has proved extremely effective for those suffering from a variety of chronic conditions including migraines, vertigo, sciatica, fibromyalgia, back pain, neck pain, TMJ dysfunction and more. 

To schedule a consultation with Dr. Kalan Stittleburg please call 715-895-8048 for our Altoona office or 507-322-0133 for our Plainview Office. To learn more about our practice visit our website at www.trilliumspinalcare.com

We would love to see if our unique form of care can help you find the relief you have been looking for.

If would like to learn even more about Upper Cervical Care please visit https://uppercervicalawareness.com/
